item.title: Cape Town-made David climbs US charts, delights global audiences
item.description: South African animated movie David is drawing audiences and praise across North America. It opened to an estimated USD 22 million in its first weekend, marking Angel Studios’ strongest theatrical debut, reports Cape {town} Etc.

item.title: Watch: 62m Superyacht SALT docks in Cape Town’s harbour
item.description: The superyacht SALT has docked at Cape Town’s V&A Waterfront. Local visitors and boat fans have posted photos and short videos online, reports Cape {town} Etc. 'Sailed out to sea today and of course the superyacht Salt continues to steal the show,' an Instagram user wrote.

item.title: Injured firefighter airlifted to safety in Stettynskloof mountains
item.description: A stricken firefighter spent a night on steep Stettynskloof slopes after suffering a leg injury while working on a remote fire line, reports Cape {town} Etc.
